detail.longDescription: OK so Mastodon just paid for itself. I posted something, and some intolerant Karen decided to report my post, for reason 'other'. Her report was taken very seriously. It was forwarded straight to the senior administrator / owners of the server which my mastodon account is on. That would be... me. I will have you know I took that report very seriously. I was going to print it off to use as toilet paper, but my printer was out of toner (shame). So, I just instantly dismissed the report. Thank you Karen. # karen # selfhosted # mastodonserver # intolerance
